title: Longest Common Subsequence
description: Write a Zig program that finds the length of the longest common subsequence between two strings using dynamic programming.
hints: LCS uses dynamic programming with a 2D table where dp[i][j] = LCS length for prefixes
If characters differ: dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
Use `@max()` built-in for finding the maximum of two values
